details.description: A great start for new users, a wonderful upgrade for those already using cups. The Carmesi Menstrual Cup is so incredibly soft, that it is an absolute delight to use. It bends with your body so you never feel like you're wearing anything at all. Not even when you are inserting it. Made with 100% Biocompatible Medical Grade Silicone, the Carmesi Menstrual Cup is designed for a safe and sustainable period. Use the cup for a period you'll hardly notice.
details.usageInstructions:
1. CLEAN IT - Wash the cup by placing in boiling water for 7 mins. Dry & cool it before use.
2. FOLD IT - Fold the cup to form a U shape with your thumb and forefinger.
3. INSERT IT - Relax your body & insert the cup in your vagina while pushing it upwards.
4. REMOVE IT - Pinch the base of the cup and squeeze to release the vacuum, & gently pull it out.
NOTE: Empty the cup and wash it with water before inserting it again. Follow step 1 to clean and sterilise before storing it.
